- src/main/java/com/example/DenyShadow.kt:13:5: DenyListedApi: runCatching has hidden issues when used with coroutines as it catches and doesn't rethrow CancellationException. This can interfere with coroutines cancellation handling! Prefer catching specific exceptions based on the current case. # the file declares its own top-level runCatching, which Kotlin resolves ahead of the default-imported kotlin.runCatching; Lint's UAST resolves the call to the stdlib function anyway
